description: Ministry of Home Affairs - Notify the Regulations of Walukarama Maha Viharaya Esala Perahera of Bambalapitiya, Thimbirigasyaya D/ S Division under the Pilgrimage Ordinance
categorisation: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Home Affairs under the Pilgrimages Ordinance (Chapter 175). It establishes a legal/regulatory framework for managing pilgrimages during a specific festival, including provisions for traffic control, sanitation, food safety, and public health measures. The content focuses on creating binding rules and compliance requirements rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
